column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the icsstruct warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Lexical Layer: Every Physical Line in Exactly One Record, Malformed Lines Carried With a Reason
The Stubs: Checked Against the Libraries They Describe, Constructors the Only Allowed Divergence
The Expansion Layer: One Occurrence per Instance in an Overlapping Window, Unexpandable Events Carried
The Source Edge: A Secret URL Is Read Once and Reaches No Record, Label or Error
The Command: One Line per Occurrence, Every Defect on the Page, Each Source by Its Label
